Text: ugly in the comic way: a huge droopy or bulbous potato nose, bulging round eyes with tiny pupils, buck teeth or crooked teeth in an overbite grin, weak or stubbly chin, big ears, wild greasy hair or a bald dome with a few hairs, gangly limbs with knobbly knees OR a pot belly on thin legs, enormous hands and feet
Notes: What makes it Marcinelle: caricature by exaggeration, never by animal parts (no pig noses, no round ball heads).

Text: bold, wobbly, confident black brush-ink outlines with thick and thin strokes, hand-drawn comic panel look, sweat drops and motion lines
Notes: The ink is the style. A clean vector line is wrong.
